 Vets Adopting Pets on Federal Holiday 
 Vets Adopting Pets on Federal Holiday
 News 
 Yesterday, 08:55 PM 
 Susan Wenner 
 By Lesley Keays
 Herald Staff Writer 
 On November 11, Veterans’ Day, Decision Tactical is partnering with Pet Rescue by Judy to offer US veterans free adoptions of adult dogs and cats. All animals will be spayed or neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, allowing veterans to welcome a rescue pet into their homes at no cost.
 The initiative brings together two important causes: recognizing the sacrifices of local veterans while giving shelter animals a chance to find loving, forever homes. It's also an opportunity to highlight the companionship and comfort rescue animals can bring to veterans.
 To adopt, candidates bring a valid Veteran ID, complete an adoption application, and meet the pet first. Dogs also require a family meet at the rescue shelter. Note: Dogs available for adoptions are companions, not service dogs.
 Decision Tactical is a 43,000-square-foot indoor tactical theme park and training facility located in Sanford. 
 For more information about Decision Tactical, access www.decisiontactical.com.
 Pet Rescue By Judy is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, no-kill animal shelter in Sanford dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming companion animals.
 For more information about Pet Rescue By Judy, access  www.petrescuebyjudy.com .
